lines.text: Israel camps in the plains of Moab near the Jordan, and Moab is terrified of them.
Balak sends messengers to summon Balaam at Pethor by the Nile to put a curse on Israel.
God tells Balaam not to go with Balak's men or curse the people, because they are blessed.
God tells Balaam to go with the men but do only what He says, so Balaam saddles his donkey.
The donkey presses against the wall and crushes Balaam's hand, then lies down under him, and he beats her.
